claims.claim: Batch API wydany pazdziernik 2024 oferuje 50% discount na BOTH input and output tokens, SLA 1-24h
claims.citation: Anthropic Batch API (wydany pazdziernik 2024) oferuje 50% discount na input i output tokeny w zamian za async processing z SLA do 24 godzin.

claims.claim: Batch + Cache stacking: 50% * 10% = 5% of base input price = 95% TOTAL discount vs regular rate
claims.citation: Po stackingu: 50% batch * 10% cache read = 5% of base input price per read, co z Sonnet 4.6 daje $0.15/MTok zamiast $3/MTok (95% savings).

claims.claim: Cache hits w batch sa 'best-effort' - concurrent processing, hit rate 30-98% zalezne od traffic pattern
claims.citation: Cache hits w batch sa best-effort. Poniewaz batch requests processuja sie concurrently w jakimkolwiek kolejnosci, niektore requesty moga nie trafic na pre-existing cache. Obserwowane cache hit rates w batch to 30%-98%.

claims.claim: Priming pattern: 1 request z 1h TTL cache_control wpisuje cache, potem batch 1000 requests czyta - wszystkie hit
claims.citation: Step 1: Wyslij 1 request z 'ttl': '1h' i cache_control na wspolnym prefiksie, czekaj na response (cache jest napisany). Step 2: Wyslij batch z tym samym prefiksem - wszystkie requesty w batch trafia na cache napisany w kroku 1.

claims.claim: Batch NIE jest kompatybilny z: Fast mode (Opus 4.6 only), Managed Agents (stateful), real-time/streaming
claims.citation: Batch NIE jest kompatybilny z: Fast mode (Opus 4.6 only), Claude Managed Agents, Real-time use cases. Streaming responses, synchronous UI integration.

claims.claim: Sonnet 4.6 effective rates: Batch regular $1.50, Batch+5m write $1.875, Batch+1h write $3, Batch+read $0.15 /MTok input
claims.citation: Sonnet 4.6 compound pricing: Regular $3/MTok, Batch regular $1.50, Batch + 5m cache write $1.875, Batch + 1h cache write $3, Batch + cache read $0.15.

claims.claim: Priming example: 50k prefix, 1000 requests Sonnet 4.6: no-opt $150, Batch only $75, Cache only $15.29, Batch+Cache $7.79 = 94.8% savings
claims.citation: Oszczednosc w liczbach (50k-token prefix, 1000 requests, Sonnet 4.6): No cache no batch: $150. Batch only: $75. Cache only: $15.29. Cache + batch: ~$7.79. Total savings: $150 -> $7.79 = 94.8%.

claims.claim: Haiku 4.5 + Batch + Cache = 98.3% savings vs Sonnet baseline - najtanszy bulk offline workflow
claims.citation: Haiku 4.5 + Batch + Cache: $2.55 total, 98.3% savings. Dla offline bulk work z repeated prefix, Haiku 4.5 + Batch + Cache daje 98.3% savings vs Sonnet baseline.

claims.claim: Batch + 1h TTL cache: uzyj 1h bo batch moze trwac do 24h, 5m niewystarczajace
claims.citation: 1h TTL chroni przed wygasnieciem w trakcie przetwarzania batch (batch moze trwac do 24h). Po 1h cache wygasa, pozostale requesty placa rewrite.

claims.claim: Concurrent batches z tym samym prefixem: race condition moze spowodowac 2 redundant writes zamiast 1 write + 1 read
claims.citation: Jezeli oba teams submittuja w tej samej sekundzie, kazdy batch moze napisac wlasny cache entry - 2 redundant writes zamiast 1 write + 1 read. Efektywny cache hit rate dla batch_B wtedy bedzie okolo 50%.

claims.claim: Batch + 1h write placisz 2x base = tyle samo co regular input, ale daje prawo do 1h tanich reads dla kolejnych batches
claims.citation: Batch + 1h write jest tyle samo co regular input - ale daje prawo do 1h tanich reads dla kolejnych batches.

claims.claim: Batch dziala z tool use, multi-turn self-contained, images+text mix, system+tools+messages caching
claims.citation: Co dziala mimo ograniczen: Tool use dziala, tool_result bloki cache'uja sie normalnie. Multi-turn conversations w kazdym batch request. Images + text mix. System + tools + messages caching.

claims.claim: Anthropic czerwiec 2025: 1h extended TTL launch 'reduces costs 90%, latency 85%' - implicitly promuje batch patterns
claims.citation: Czer 2025: @AnthropicAI: 'we now offer an extended 1-hour TTL. This reduces costs by up to 90% and reduces latency by up to 85% for long prompts, making extended agent workflows more practical.'

claims.claim: LangChain AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware wspiera Batch endpoint, wymaga explicite ustawienia ttl='1h' dla batch
claims.citation: LangChain AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware dziala dla Batch endpointu, ale wymaga explicite ustawienia ttl='1h' w middleware config dla optimal batch processing.

claims.claim: AWS Bedrock wspiera Batch + cache od 2026-Q1 - enterprise adoption path
claims.citation: AWS Bedrock: Batch + cache od 2026-Q1 support. Wymaga Bedrock Batch Inference feature.

claims.claim: LLMindset 'up to 95% discount' mylace - 95% od regular baseline, nie od batch
claims.citation: LLMindset pisze ze Batch daje 'up to 95% discount' - to niedokladne. 50% batch + 90% cache read = 95% od baseline, ale nie 95% od batch. Precyzyjna matematyka: Batch + Cache = 0.5 * 0.1 = 5% of base input price.

claims.claim: Shared prefix dla batch wymaga bajt-za-bajtem matching - jakakolwiek zmiana (whitespace, capitalization) kasuje
claims.citation: Priming pattern wymaga precyzyjnego bajt-za-bajtem matching shared prefix. Jakakolwiek zmiana (whitespace, capitalization) kasuje.

claims.claim: Alert threshold: Batch response cache_read_ratio < 50% = problem z prefix drift lub timing
claims.citation: Monitoruj: loguj batch response cache_read_input_tokens vs cache_creation. Alert <50% read ratio.

claims.claim: Fallback plan: jesli Batch + Cache hit rate < 60%, zbadaj czy masz drift w shared prefix
claims.citation: Fallback plan: jezeli Batch + Cache hit rate < 60%, zbaduj czy masz drift w shared prefix (capitalization, whitespace).

claims.claim: Batch + Cache stacking to najbardziej niewykorzystywany money-saver w Anthropic stack - 95%+ discount rutynowo osiagalne
claims.citation: Batch + Cache stacking to najbardziej niewykorzystywany money-saver w stack Anthropic. Dla offline bulk 95%+ discount rutynowo osiagalne.
